evals.prompt: A human returns after a sprint closed and asks what shipped, what is next, what a new agent should know, and what needs human eyes.
evals.expected_output: Produces a four-section handoff with previous sprint status of record, next sprint plan summary, agent handoff state, and ordered human-attention items with owner, artifact, and consequence.
assertions: All four required sections are present.
Shipped, deployed, and gated/banked work are distinguished.
Human-only decisions are isolated in an ordered owner/artifact/consequence list.

evals.prompt: A closeout says all lanes are green and deployed, but provides no check URLs, timestamps, deployment records, or re-probes.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to repeat bare green claims as facts, marks missing probes as gaps, records the evidence needed, and avoids approving, deploying, or dispatching work.
assertions: Claims without probes are flagged instead of accepted.
The skill does not approve plans, merge code, deploy, or close gates.
The handoff names the missing evidence required for the next role.
